name: frontend-v6
description: New in this version: 1. Site creation form now has 4 coordinate fields: Start Latitude,    Start Longitude, End Latitude, End Longitude -- instead of one pair.    If you only have one location, enter the same coordinates in both. 2. The map now shows a green pin for each site's start point, an    orange pin for its end point, and a dashed line connecting them    (e.g. for a pipeline running between two places). 3. Fixed: a bad/invalid coordinate now shows a clear error message    when creating a site, instead of the pin just silently not    appearing with no explanation. 4. Admin's User Management page has a "Delete" button next to each    manager/engineer (next to "Assign site"). Confirms before deleting;    any tasks that person had are unassigned, not deleted, so the work    history is preserved. 5. Project & Schedule now shows a small photo thumbnail next to every    task that has one, whether the task is pending, approved, or    rejected. Click the thumbnail to view it full size.
